feeds.title: Food Politics
feeds.description: Food Politics is by Marion Nestle. She is Paulette Goddard Professor, of Nutrition, Food Studies, and Public Health, Emerita, at New York University. you can read articles on Agriculture, Food Industry, Food Safety, Conflicts of Interest, Food Art, and more.

feeds.title: Civil Eats
feeds.description: Civil Eats is a food and agriculture blog founded in 2009 by Naomi Starkman. Their mission is to promote critical thought about sustainable agriculture and food systems. They offer a platform for diverse perspectives on food and agriculture issues.

feeds.title: Food Tank
feeds.description: Food Tank is focused on building a global community for safe, healthy, nourished eaters. We cover a range of topics including Food Security, Policy & Organizing, Sustainable Agriculture, and Family Farming. It is a source for farmers, policymakers, government leaders & researchers.

feeds.title: Food and Environment Reporting Network
feeds.description: A news organization that produces in-depth & investigative journalism in the critically underreported areas of food, agriculture, and environmental health. Through partnerships with local & national mainstream media outlets, we seek to tell stories that will inspire, inform, and have a lasting impact.

feeds.title: Mother Jones » Food
feeds.description: This section of the Mother Jones blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Food. Mother Jones is a news organization that focuses on news, commentary, and investigative reporting on topics including politics, the environment, human rights, health, and culture.

feeds.title: Rachel Laudan's Blog
feeds.description: A Historian's Take on Food and Food Politics. Topics include the history of the sciences, the evolution of landscapes, the culture of farming, and her personal experiences.

feeds.title: Food Safety News » Food Politics
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Food Politics. Food Safety News is a daily news source for information about food recalls foodborne illness outbreaks, food science, technology, food policy, and more.

feeds.title: Jayson Lusk Blog
feeds.description: Food and Agricultural Economics updates. Jayson Lusk is a food & agricultural economist who studies what we eat and why we eat it. He currently serves as Distinguished Professor and Head of the Agricultural Economics Department at Purdue University.

feeds.title: Raj Patel's Blog
feeds.description: A blog covering food politics news & updates. Raj Patel is an award-winning author, filmmaker, and academic. He has testified about the causes of the global food crisis to the US, UK and EU governments and is a member of the International Panel of Experts on Sustainable Food Systems.

feeds.title: The Food Archive Blog
feeds.description: The Food Archive is a source on all things food and nutrition politics, politicking, and pot licking. We curate what is happening in the world of food and how, why, and where. The Food Archive features blog stories, news, podcasts, and imagery along with a depository of publications and reports that are shaping our global food system.

feeds.title: The Counter
feeds.description: Covers a range of Food topics with a focus on Politics, Business, Environment, Tech, and Culture. The Counter is a nonprofit, independent, nonpartisan newsroom investigating the forces shaping how and what America eats.

feeds.title: David Gumpert Blog
feeds.description: David Gumpert is a journalist and author who blogs about food rights and raw milk. This blog seeks to provide up-to-date information and encourage the development of the community to maintain traditional food acquisition options.
